items.quote: Tamon Wilova took ownership of delivery under pressure through a demanding year-end peak and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Tamon Wilova championed long-term strategy for the sector and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
He championed upholding governance and audit standards and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Tamon Wilova set the direction for customer feedback improvements at service centres across the public service.
Tamon managed community engagement on the estate renewal plan for his unit.
He took ownership of mapping interdependencies across agencies and steered it to completion.
He headed negotiations with contractors on the service agreement, setting priorities for several teams.
Tamon Wilova spearheaded the partnership with sister agencies on youth services at the national level.
Peers observed that Tamon set the direction for cost savings across procurement across the public service.
Peers observed that Tamon delivered his share of capability building for new hires reliably.
